### Problem Description
Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly.
*Example: I am always frustrated when trying to track which hackathons my teammates have already registered for.*

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Include UI mockups or workflow descriptions if available.

### Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

### Target Audience
Who benefits most from this feature? (e.g. Students, Hackathon Organizers, Community Moderators)

### Additional Context
Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.
